india_trends.title: Economist Neelkanth Mishra appointed India’s Executive Director at World Bank

His three-year tenure will begin after Iyer's tenure is extended to ensure a smooth transition.

Broader markets outperformed despite recent corrections, while investors awaited the RBI policy decision and GDP data. Analysts flagged 23,500 as a key resistance and 23,300–23,200 as important support levels.

india_trends.title: Microfinance NPAs may edge up in FY27 as write-off practices normalise: CareEdge
india_trends.summary: Forecasts for FY27 suggest a modest rise in bad loans for microfinance institutions, a development stemming from the adjustments following the post-pandemic surge. The upcoming FY26 is predicted to offer some respite through accelerated write-offs, yet lenders are tightening their belts.

india_trends.title: Goldman Sachs expects SpaceX's AI revenue to surge 100-fold by 2030, FT reports

india_trends.title: Titan bets on premiumisation, global expansion to double business by FY30
india_trends.summary: Titan reported a consolidated revenue of ₹76,078 crore for FY26, up 32.7% from FY25, while net profit surged 52% to ₹5,073 crore. The country's largest jewellery retailer is targeting a two-fold increase in consolidated revenue and operating profit by FY30 compared with FY26 levels.

india_trends.title: IndiGo suspends flights to 6 international destinations: Is your dream holiday affected? Check full list
india_trends.summary: IndiGo international flights suspended: IndiGo has temporarily suspended flights to six international destinations, including Hong Kong and Krabi, from July 1 to September 30. This strategic move is attributed to traditionally softer demand in the upcoming quarter and a challenging cost environment.
